status: ASSUMPTION A9c hot-winding resistance ceiling; NOT RUN

external_datum.name: IEC standard-copper resistance temperature coefficient at 20 C as reproduced by NIST Copper Wire Tables
external_datum.source_boundary: The coefficient describes standard/good annealed copper. It does not establish this winding's manufactured resistance, joints, insulation build or pre-shot temperature.

rules.selector_overhead: A9b source-energy increment over the A7c 1.25x controlling reference corner is held fixed.
rules.resistance_interpolation: A7c reference source energy is linear in the phase-resistance multiplier under its fixed current/force model; use the committed 1.00x and 1.25x corners to recover the exact slope.
rules.temperature_conversion: Convert the derived maximum R/R20 ratio with R/R20 = 1 + alpha20*(T-20 C). This is a pure-copper ceiling, not an operating-temperature requirement.
